prompt:

Asset type: PhysicsOS sidebar navigation icon, a single isolated icon to display at 16 or 18 pixels.
Primary request: one simple file folder outline for the Projects entry. Show a front-facing folder with a short raised tab at its top left, no contents and no extra symbols.
Style/medium: minimal monochrome UI outline icon; smooth, geometric, uniform bold strokes with rounded caps and rounded joins.
Composition/framing: centered in a square, icon spanning approximately 78% of the canvas width, with generous clean margins; orthographic front view. Line thickness approximately 8% of the icon width so it stays readable at 16 pixels.

Color palette: only solid black outlines and pure white empty regions.
Constraints: one icon only; clean closed outline; every detail legible at tiny size; no lettering, digits, labels, watermark, texture, gradients, gray shading, drop shadows, perspective or decorative border. Do not draw a filled black silhouette.
